dedupe_keys.name: geolocating and measuring offshore infrastructure in scottish waters with sentinel 1 and sentinel 2 data

description: This dataset and code implement an automatic method for locating offshore infrastructure and estimating its size in Scottish waters by combining Sentinel-1 SAR data with Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery. Three strategies, a transformed median composite, two-dimensional singular spectrum analysis filtering and threshold segmentation, first extract the contour range of structures on Sentinel-1, and morphological operations on Sentinel-2 true colour images then give the precise location and size of each oil and gas platform and wind turbine. The deposit includes the MATLAB scripts for each step and the Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 input data (about 101 MB), which the authors obtained from the Sentinel Hub EO Browser. It was produced by Ping Ma, Sally Rouse, Jinchang Ren and Malcolm Macdonald and published on Zenodo in several versions from March 2022; the latest version is downloadable under CC BY 4.0, while earlier versions show no licence. Caveats: it covers one sea region, needs MATLAB, and earlier versions carry no licence. It is useful for building offshore asset inventories for hazard exposure and marine spatial planning and for monitoring energy infrastructure change; a related record is the open pipeline for detecting critical infrastructure from satellite imagery.
